components.gap: Not every empirical claim keeps its study/task/population/uncertainty boundaries. (a) The Aristotle-thesis report at lines 261-265 names no study (source p. 280: Pfeifer 2012; Pfeifer & Tulkki 2017b) and no task (source: participants judged that AT1 and AT2 must be true). It also does not say that population, design and uncertainty are unreported. The reporting-limit paragraph at 564-567 covers only the bulleted 'collection of studies' at 540-562, so it does not reach this report. (b) The truth-table report at 513-516 and most bulleted reports at 541-561 do not say which cited study supports which claim. The source names Wason & Johnson-Laird 1972 for the truth-table task, Pfeifer & Kleiter 2005 for AND, Pfeifer & Kleiter 2005/2006b/2010 and Pfeifer & Tulkki 2017b for System P, Pfeifer & Kleiter 2006b/2010 for transitivity read as CUT, and Over et al. 2007, Pfeifer & Stockle-Schobel 2015 and Pfeifer & Tulkki 2017a for causal, counterfactual and abductive conditionals. (c) Line 494 sends the strengthening/contraposition report to sec:p15-w02b-p15-038-evidence-boundaries, but that subsection treats only argument (3) and modus ponens. Fix: add study identification and task/population/uncertainty boundaries for the Aristotle report and the other reports, and correct the cross-reference.
